# # Dependency Trace: Jackson ObjectMapper through Spring Framework to Spring Boot

## Context

Jackson is the default JSON library in the Spring ecosystem. When a developer
registers a custom Jackson Module bean in a Spring Boot application, it should
be auto-detected and applied to all REST endpoints. But the path from bean
definition to actual serialization crosses three repositories:

- Jackson provides ObjectMapper and the Module registration API
- Spring Framework provides Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder and MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter
- Spring Boot provides JacksonAutoConfiguration that wires everything together

## Task

Trace how a custom Jackson Module bean flows from Spring Boot autoconfiguration
through Spring Framework's builder into Jackson's ObjectMapper.

## Repos in Workspace

- `/workspace/jackson-databind/` -- jackson-databind 2.15.2 (upstream library)
- `/workspace/spring-framework/` -- Spring Framework 6.0.11 (intermediary)
- `/workspace/spring-boot/` -- Spring Boot 3.1.2 (consumer/autoconfigurer)

## Expected Output

Write `/workspace/DEPENDENCY_TRACE.md` containing:

1. Key classes and methods in jackson-databind for module registration
2. How Spring Framework's Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder and MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter integrate with Jackson
3. How Spring Boot's JacksonAutoConfiguration auto-detects and registers Module beans
4. The complete class/method chain from Module bean to REST serialization

# Dependency Trace: Jackson Module Bean → REST Serialization

## Overview

This document traces how a custom `Jackson Module` bean defined in a Spring Boot application flows through Spring Boot autoconfiguration, Spring Framework's `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder`, into Jackson's `ObjectMapper`, and finally to REST response serialization via `MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter`.

---

## 1. Jackson-Databind: Module Registration API

**Repository:** `github.com/sg-evals/jackson-databind--jackson-databind-2.15.2`

### `com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.Module` (abstract class)

[`Module.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jackson-databind--jackson-databind-2.15.2/-/blob/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/Module.java?L25-L76)

The entry point for all Jackson extensions. Every custom module must extend this class and implement:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `getModuleName()` | Human-readable name; must be non-null |
| `version()` | Module version; must be non-null |
| `setupModule(SetupContext context)` | Called by `ObjectMapper` during registration to install serializers, deserializers, type modifiers, etc. |
| `getTypeId()` | Returns `getClass().getName()` by default; used to deduplicate registrations |
| `getDependencies()` | Returns other `Module` instances that must be registered first |

### `com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper` — Module registration methods

[`ObjectMapper.java` L842–L879](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jackson-databind--jackson-databind-2.15.2/-/blob/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/ObjectMapper.java?L842-L879)

```java
public ObjectMapper registerModule(Module module)                          // L842
public ObjectMapper registerModules(Module... modules)                     // L1058
public ObjectMapper registerModules(Iterable<? extends Module> modules)   // L1077
public static List<Module> findModules(ClassLoader classLoader)            // L1127
public ObjectMapper findAndRegisterModules()                               // L1164
```

**`registerModule` execution flow** ([L842–L999](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jackson-databind--jackson-databind-2.15.2/-/blob/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/ObjectMapper.java?L842-L999)):

1. Validates non-null name and version.
2. Recursively registers any modules from `module.getDependencies()`.
3. Checks `_registeredModuleTypes` (`LinkedHashSet`) using `module.getTypeId()` as key; skips if already registered (when `IGNORE_DUPLICATE_MODULE_REGISTRATIONS` is enabled).
4. Calls `module.setupModule(new Module.SetupContext() { ... })` — an anonymous inner class that delegates all mutations back to the owning `ObjectMapper`:
   - `addSerializers(Serializers s)` → mutates `_serializerFactory`
   - `addDeserializers(Deserializers d)` → mutates `_deserializationContext._factory`
   - `addBeanSerializerModifier(...)`, `addBeanDeserializerModifier(...)`, type modifiers, mix-ins, subtypes, etc.

---

## 2. Spring Framework: `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder` and `MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter`

**Repository:** `github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11`

### `org.springframework.http.converter.json.Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder`

[`Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java)

Spring's fluent builder bridging Spring configuration and Jackson's `ObjectMapper`. Key module-related fields:

| Field | Role |
|---|---|
| `this.modules` | Explicit `List<Module>` instances to register |
| `this.moduleClasses` | Module classes to instantiate and register |
| `this.findModulesViaServiceLoader` | Uses `ObjectMapper.findModules()` via JDK `ServiceLoader` |
| `this.findWellKnownModules` | Auto-registers JSR-310, Joda-Time, Kotlin modules if on classpath |

#### Module accumulation methods

```java
// Replace module list; DISABLES findWellKnownModules
modules(Module... modules)                                // L536
modules(List<Module> modules)                             // L546
modules(Consumer<List<Module>> consumer)                  // L561

// Append to module list; KEEPS findWellKnownModules = true
modulesToInstall(Module... modules)                       // L583
modulesToInstall(Consumer<List<Module>> consumer)         // L597
modulesToInstall(Class<? extends Module>... modules)      // L620
```

This distinction matters: Spring Boot uses `modulesToInstall(...)` so that explicit bean-supplied modules coexist with auto-detected well-known modules (JavaTimeModule, etc.).

#### `build()` → `configure(ObjectMapper)` — the registration pipeline

[`build()` L691–L703](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java?L691-L703) → [`configure(ObjectMapper)` L710–L793](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java?L710-L793)

```java
// Step 1 – collect modules into a deduplication map keyed by typeId
MultiValueMap<Object, Module> modulesToRegister = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();
if (this.findWellKnownModules) {
    registerWellKnownModulesIfAvailable(modulesToRegister);  // JavaTimeModule, etc.
}
// Step 2 – add explicitly specified modules
if (this.modules != null) {
    this.modules.forEach(m -> registerModule(m, modulesToRegister));
}
// Step 3 – flush deduplicated list into Jackson
objectMapper.registerModules(flattenedList);   // → ObjectMapper.registerModules()
```

Private deduplication ([L795–L802](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java?L795-L802)): modules with a non-null `typeId` use `map.set(typeId, module)` (last-wins); those without one (bare `SimpleModule()`) use `map.add(...)` (allows duplicates).

### `org.springframework.http.converter.json.AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter`

[`AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java)

Holds `protected ObjectMapper defaultObjectMapper` ([L95](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java?L95)).

**Write path** ([`writeInternal` L440–L493](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java?L440-L493)):
1. `selectObjectMapper(clazz, contentType)` picks the right mapper.
2. `objectMapper.getFactory().createGenerator(outputStream, encoding)` opens a `JsonGenerator`.
3. `objectMapper.writer()` returns an `ObjectWriter` backed by the mapper's `_serializerFactory` — which contains all serializers registered by modules.
4. `objectWriter.writeValue(generator, value)` performs the actual serialization.

**Read path** ([`readJavaType` L365–L407](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java?L365-L407)): symmetric — `objectMapper.reader().forType(javaType).readValue(inputStream)`.

### `org.springframework.http.converter.json.MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter`

[`MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java?L58-L73)

Two constructors — Spring Boot uses the second:

```java
// Default (no beans): creates its own ObjectMapper via builder.json().build()
public MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter()                           // L62
// Spring Boot path: injects the pre-configured @Primary ObjectMapper bean
public MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter(ObjectMapper objectMapper)  // L71
```

### `WebMvcConfigurationSupport.addDefaultHttpMessageConverters`

[L910–L916](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-webmvc/src/main/java/org/springframework/web/servlet/config/annotation/WebMvcConfigurationSupport.java?L910-L916) — without Spring Boot, this creates a bare converter with no module beans. Spring Boot's `JacksonHttpMessageConvertersConfiguration` replaces this path by declaring a `MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter` bean that wraps the pre-built `ObjectMapper`.

---

## 3. Spring Boot: `JacksonAutoConfiguration` — Auto-Detecting Module Beans

**Repository:** `github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2`

### `JacksonAutoConfiguration`

[`JacksonAutoConfiguration.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java)

Activated by `@AutoConfiguration` + `@ConditionalOnClass(ObjectMapper.class)`. Four inner configuration classes collaborate:

#### 3a. `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizerConfiguration` — collecting Module beans

[L172–L343](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L172-L343)

```java
@Bean
StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer standardJacksonObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer(
        JacksonProperties jacksonProperties,
        ObjectProvider<Module> modules) {         // ALL Module beans injected here
    return new StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer(
                jacksonProperties,
                modules.stream().toList());        // every Module bean in the context
}
```

`ObjectProvider<Module>` resolves every bean whose type is or extends `com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.Module`, including user-defined `@Bean`s.

When `customize(builder)` runs ([L306–L308](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L306-L308)):

```java
private void configureModules(Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder builder) {
    builder.modulesToInstall(this.modules.toArray(new Module[0]));
}
```

#### 3b. `JacksonObjectMapperBuilderConfiguration` — creating the builder

[L148–L170](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L148-L170) — `@Scope("prototype")` bean. Applies all `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer` beans (including the one above), then returns the configured builder.

#### 3c. `JacksonObjectMapperConfiguration` — the `@Primary` ObjectMapper bean

[L127–L132](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L127-L132):

```java
@Bean @Primary @ConditionalOnMissingBean
ObjectMapper jacksonObjectMapper(Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder builder) {
    return builder.createXmlMapper(false).build();
    // → Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.configure() → ObjectMapper.registerModules()
}
```

#### 3d. Built-in Module beans (all picked up by `ObjectProvider<Module>`)

| Bean | Line |
|---|---|
| `JsonComponentModule` | L99 |
| `JsonMixinModule` | L115 |
| `ParameterNamesModule` | L142 |

### `JacksonHttpMessageConvertersConfiguration` — wiring the converter

[L47–L54](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/http/JacksonHttpMessageConvertersConfiguration.java?L47-L54):

```java
@Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean(MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter.class, ...)
MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter mappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter(
        ObjectMapper objectMapper) {   // injects the @Primary ObjectMapper
    return new MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter(objectMapper);
}
```

## 4. Complete Class/Method Chain

```
User code
  @Bean MyModule myModule() { return new MyModule(); }
      |
      | (Spring context: all Module-typed beans collected via ObjectProvider<Module>)
      v
JacksonAutoConfiguration.Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizerConfiguration
  .standardJacksonObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer(JacksonProperties, ObjectProvider<Module>)
      |
      | modules.stream().toList()
      v
  StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer
    .customize(Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder builder)
      .configureModules(builder)
        → builder.modulesToInstall(modules.toArray(...))     [Spring Framework]
            sets builder.modules = [MyModule, JsonComponentModule,
                                    JsonMixinModule, ParameterNamesModule, ...]
            sets builder.findWellKnownModules = true
      |
      v
JacksonAutoConfiguration.JacksonObjectMapperBuilderConfiguration
  .jacksonObjectMapperBuilder(ctx, customizers)
    → new Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder()
    → customizer.customize(builder)  [above]
    → return builder                                         [Spring Framework]
      |
      v
JacksonAutoConfiguration.JacksonObjectMapperConfiguration
  .jacksonObjectMapper(Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder builder)
    → builder.createXmlMapper(false).build()
      |
      v
Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.build()                          [Spring Framework]
  → new ObjectMapper()
  → configure(objectMapper)
      → registerWellKnownModulesIfAvailable(modulesToRegister)
          [adds JavaTimeModule, Jdk8Module, KotlinModule if on classpath]
      → this.modules.forEach(m -> registerModule(m, modulesToRegister))
          [adds MyModule, JsonComponentModule, JsonMixinModule, ParameterNamesModule]
      → objectMapper.registerModules(flattenedList)          [Jackson]
          |
          v
ObjectMapper.registerModules(Iterable<Module>)               [Jackson]
  → for each module: registerModule(module)
      → module.getDependencies() → register deps recursively
      → check _registeredModuleTypes for duplicate typeId
      → module.setupModule(new SetupContext() { ... })
          → context.addSerializers(...)    → _serializerFactory mutated
          → context.addDeserializers(...) → _deserializationContext._factory mutated
          → context.addBeanSerializerModifier(...)
          → ... other hooks
          |
          | ObjectMapper now fully configured with all module contributions
          v
JacksonHttpMessageConvertersConfiguration
  .MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverterConfiguration
    .mappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter(ObjectMapper objectMapper)
      → new MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter(objectMapper)
          |
          | converter registered with Spring MVC's RequestMappingHandlerAdapter
          v
HTTP request → DispatcherServlet
  → RequestMappingHandlerAdapter.invokeHandlerMethod()
  → @ResponseBody / ResponseEntity return value
  → AbstractMessageConverterMethodProcessor.writeWithMessageConverters()
      → MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter.write()
          → AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.writeInternal()
              → objectMapper.writer()
              → objectWriter.writeValue(generator, value)
                  → Custom serializers from MyModule.setupModule() are invoked
```
